The <b>Far Fields</b> is an [[Areas (Silksong)|area]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is characterised by expansive grassy caverns and wind updrafts.

== Description ==
The Far Fields is a large area in the eastern lowlands of [[Pharloom]], known for grassy caverns and wind updrafts. Many passages are unreachable without the [[Drifter's Cloak]], which allows [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to ride the strong currents of air rising through the caverns. The caves give way to treacherous lava pools on the lower floors that deal {{Damage|2|type=Fire}} upon contact.

[[File:Screenshot SS Far Fields 25.png|thumb|200px|left|Room after the Bellshrine]]
The Far Fields serves as the main route up into [[Greymoor]]. This ascent requires the [[Drifter's Cloak]]. To obtain the Drifter's Cloak, Hornet must aid the [[Seamstress]] and complete the <i>[[Flexile Spines]]</i> wish. She can then leave the area via a wind updraft after defeating or skipping [[Fourth Chorus]].

In [[Act 3]], a previously inaccessible part of the Far Fields becomes available via [[Hunter's March]]. This requires using the [[Silk Soar]] in the Hunter's March statue room. After venturing east, Hornet meets [[Skarrsinger Karmelita]], who is frail with age. Hornet can challenge her to a battle in memory with the [[Elegy of the Deep]] and claim [[Hunter's Heart|her heart]].

To the east, Hornet can meet [[Sprintmaster Swift]], who resides in the giant, boney body of a massive bug, and challenge him to a race.

== History ==
Long ago in [[Pharloom]]'s past, massive creatures roamed the area now known as the Far Fields.<ref>[[Sprintmaster Swift]] (referring to a large skeletal structure): <i>"This giant, boney body, so distant from Pharloom's ails. Here, freely, we can test our speed and our sleek shells. Here we may race!"</i></ref>

The Far Fields is home to the [[Skarr]], red-ant hunters who inhabited the land long before [[Grand Mother Silk]].<ref>[[Snail Shamans (Silksong)|Snail Shamans]]: <i>"Pharloom was not born of that monarch, Old One. Power existed in these lands even before she bound them beneath her. Grnk. Seek the old hearts of our kingdom and the last successors to bear their strength. They're still out there, hidden away, much faded by the pale one's long dominion."</i></ref> The tribe were united in service through the voice and leadership of their last song queen, [[Skarrsinger Karmelita]].<ref>Skarrsinger Karmelita [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Song queen of the Skarr and their most talented warrior. This graceful ruler once possessed skill to rival my own. At her youthful peak, her voice united all Skarr in her service."</i></ref> She protected the Skarr from the [[Haunting]] for many years and gave the tribe the strength to resist it.<ref>Snail Shamans: <i>"In youth, her voice united the wild tribes. Gave them the strength to resist the pale monarch's will... longer than most at least."</i></ref> Her presence was also what caused the area's flora to grow.<ref>Hornet and [[Gilly]] dialogue: <br><i>Gilly: "This giant, old ant... Her death seems recent, but her presence here... Was it her? Could it be? The strength that sustained these caves? If so, what will happen now?"<br>Hornet: "They will wither and fade..."</i></ref> The Skarr still hunt other creatures in the land, such as [[Flapping Fertid]]s and [[Hardbone Elder]]s.

[[File:Screenshot SS Far Fields 02.png|thumb|200px|right|Fourth Chorus idle under a pile of rubble]]
At some point during the reign of [[the Citadel]], [[Fourth Chorus]], a towering machine of cogs and iron, was deployed in the area. It is assumed that Fourth Chorus was sent to hunt down the [[Seamstress]].<ref>[[Pinstress]]: <i>"Our grand Citadel learnt well from the training of Pinstresses past. Then it went and turned those teachings upon us! Despite our superior skills, our numbers have always been few, and their strength overwhelmed."</i></ref> The automaton engaged her in battle in the Far Fields before she subdued it by impaling her pin into its neck and leaving it buried under rubble.<ref>The internal name for the lodged pin is <code>Room_Umbrella_hang_pins</code> – "umbrella" being the internal name for sprites related to the Seamstress and her airship. The pin's design is also identical to the ones used by [[Pinstress]] and the dead pin-sister in the [[Putrified Ducts]].</ref> It sits idle in the lava to this day.

== How to Access ==
The main entrance to the Far Fields is accessed from the [[Deep Docks]]. Hornet can reach it by defeating [[Lace]] in the arena directly north of [[Forge Daughter]]. Beyond her arena, a [[Bellshrine]] can be rung to open a gate to the Far Fields. The [[Swift Step]] is required to leap over a lava gap past the gate.

Lace's battle can be [[Lace#In-game Events|completely skipped]] via an alternative passage. By using a [[Simple Key (Silksong)|Simple Key]] on the door directly south of Forge Daughter (which also requires a Swift Step jump), Hornet can travel east through a few chambers of enemies to reach the lower entrance to the Far Fields.

Additionally, if Hornet has already visited either the [[Blasted Steps]] or [[Sinner's Road]] by going through the [[Wormways]], Lace does not appear in the Deep Docks.

<b>Pilgrim's Rest</b> contains a building that can be entered for {{R|30}} each time. Inside are a bench and [[Mort]], a merchant. The gears inside the building can be destroyed, preventing the door from closing and thus bypassing the entry cost.

When first entering Pilgrim's Rest, [[Sherma]] can be seen and interacted with. However, he is absent upon returning to the area.

During [[Act 3]], Pilgrim's Rest is destroyed, with [[Snitchfly|Snitchflies]] scavenging its remains. The bench remains intact and can be accessed for free. Any of Mort's unbought stock moves to [[Grindle]]'s inventory, except for the [[Weighted Belt]], which can instead be found in the vertical room west of the Far Fields [[Bellway]] station.

<b>Weavenest Cindril</b> is a sub-area in the far east of the Far Fields, accessed through a [[Needolin]] door. A puzzle is found inside, with pressure plates illuminating lights placed above them when pressed. The number of lights lit above each plate increases with Hornet's speed. Sprinting across all the pressure plates without stopping grants the [[Silkspeed Anklets]] tool, which increases Hornet's movement speed at the cost of some Silk.

Equipping the Silkspeed Anklets and using the [[Flea Brew]] allows Hornet to run across the plates at even higher speeds. Doing so opens a trapdoor to a lower level. A [[Rune Harp]] lies on the ground on the left side of the lower level. On the right side is a viewing area from which the [[Wasteland]] outside Pharloom is visible.

== Special Rooms ==
=== Skull Cave ===
The Skull Cave is a room in the east of the Far Fields. The [[Clawline]] ability is needed to grasp the hooks that lead to the entrance. Upon entering, the entrance caves in and Hornet has to proceed downward, avoiding spikes and hitting multiple exploding rocks on the way.

After hitting the exploding rock at the bottom, the ground is replaced by lava, leaving two unstable rock platforms that sink shortly after being touched by either Hornet or enemies. The [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Far Fields 1|enemy gauntlet]] then begins, and once it is cleared, the upper corners of the arena break away as the lava begins rising. Hornet must climb back out of the pit to escape the lava and avoid the [[Tarmite]]s that have also spawned in. The lava stops rising at the entrance as the rubble breaks away to allow Hornet to leave, and a large wind current appears that lets Hornet float up to an upper chamber that holds a [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Mask Shard]].

The ceiling of the upper chamber has spikes to prevent Hornet from skipping the gauntlet with the [[Silk Soar]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Ember Pit.png !Location of the Skull Cave
}}

=== Frontier ===
Frontier<ref>Save profile name when resting at the [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] next to [[Sprintmaster Swift]]</ref> is a room located on the east side of the Act 3-exclusive segment of the Far Fields. Sprintmaster Swift is encountered here, and he can be challenged to a race around the room. He can initially be beaten three times, with each victory making the track more difficult.

After completing all three races and returning to Frontier, Sprintmaster Swift can be raced one final time, granting the [[Sprintmaster Memento]] if he is beaten.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Sprintmaster Swift 01.png!Location of Frontier
}}

== Creation and Development ==
{{Main|Cut Content (Silksong)/Areas#Far Fields}}
[[File:February 2019 Scorchlands.png|thumb|220px|"Scorchlands" in February 2019]]
The Far Fields rooms were first created around August 2017. During this time, the Far Fields may have been designed as an 'extension' to the Marrow instead of a fully separate area, as its room names refer to it as <code>Bone_East</code>. In this iteration, the area featured no greenery, instead being filled with rocky rooms and lava. A possible earlier name for the area is Scorchlands, used in a file name. It contained aspects of the final Far Fields, such as Fourth Chorus and the Seamstress hut, but also included the [[Diving Bell|diving bell]], due to its [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Areas#Deep Docks|older purpose]].

By November 2019, all rooms had vegetation added; this iteration of the Far Fields was then expanded until it was completed in April 2021. While the area's layout has remained largely unchanged since then up to release, the [[Act 3]]-exclusive northeastern corner of the Far Fields had a completely different design that lacked [[Skarrsinger Karmelita]], [[Gurr the Outcast]], and [[Sprintmaster Swift]]'s rooms. This section was completely reworked following the September 2021 map.

The Far Fields' old "Scorchlands" iteration was showcased in the February 2019 <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer, which included a clip of Fourth Chorus.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFAknD_9U7c Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer]</ref> In June 2020, the riddle revealing [[Huntress]] contained a GIF of her room,<ref>The [https://discordapp.com/channels/283467363729408000/586931790208434203/722196291592912906 file] where Huntress was revealed</ref> which was then part of the Far Fields, opposite Pilgrim's Rest. In February 2021's <i>EDGE Magazine</i> issue, a screenshot of Mottled Skarr in the Far Fields was shown.<ref>[https://pocketmags.com/edge-magazine/february-2021 Edge Magazine February 2021 edition], p. 54.</ref> More footage was showcased in the June 2022 <i>Xbox Game Pass Reveal Trailer</i> and surrounding promotional material; the area's name was revealed in a screenshot filename released around then.<ref name="xbox">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JSfuFlhsxZY Hollow Knight: Silksong - Xbox Game Pass Reveal Trailer - Xbox & Bethesda Games Showcase 2022]</ref><ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20221029084823/https://news.xbox.com/en-us/media/hollow-knight-silksong-xbox-bethesda-showcase-2022/ Hollow Knight: Silksong – Xbox & Bethesda Showcase 2022 - Xbox Wire (archive)]</ref>

== Trivia ==
* The Far Fields section on the zoomed-out map expands once Hornet has started to explore the area east of the tallest room that is unlocked by going through Hunter's March in Act 3.
** It is the only area to change size on the zoomed-out map, likely due to a significant portion of the area being blocked off for most of the game.
* A locked door can be seen to the right of Skarrsinger Karmelita's body. This door is never opened throughout the course of the game.
* All eight speed levels in the Weavenest Cindril puzzle are achievable. The first requires walking while holding QUICK MAP, whereas subsequent ones can be reached by walking or running with different combinations of the [[Scuttlebrace]], the [[Silkspeed Anklets]], and the [[Flea Brew]], as well as utilising Hornet's gradual deceleration when releasing SPRINT.
